inputData.originalEmail: I know you are mad but we can't refund your money because our policy says 14 days and you bought it 20 days ago. Sorry but rules are rules.
inputData.issueType: Refund request outside of return window

outputData.improvedEmail: Thank you for shopping with us. I completely understand how frustrating it can be when a product doesn't meet your expectations, and I wish we could offer a different outcome. Regrettably, because the purchase was made 20 days ago, it falls outside our standard 14-day refund policy window. To help make things right, I would love to extend a 20% discount coupon for your next order or help you find an alternative product which better fits your needs. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.
outputData.explanationOfImprovements: Replaced direct, abrupt rejection with supportive validation of the client's frustration. Highlighted the 14-day policy in a respectful tone, and actively offered supportive alternatives (discount coupon or alternative solution) to preserve the client relationship.
outputData.betterSubjectLine: Regarding your recent purchase and return request

inputData.complaint: Your delivery driver literally threw the fragile package at my door, cracking the glass screen inside. This is completely unacceptable!
inputData.resolution: Ship immediate glass replacement and supply $15 feedback credit.

outputData.empatheticReply: Dear Customer, I am incredibly sorry to hear about how your package was handled and the damage caused to your fragile glass screen. This is certainly not up to our standards, and I fully share your disappointment. I've already arranged to ship an immediate glass replacement today with priority shipping, and I've applied a $15 credit to your account as a gesture of our commitment. We are also reviewing this case directly with our shipping partner to ensure it never happens again.
outputData.apologyLine: I express our sincere apologies for the careless handling of your delicate delivery.
outputData.resolutionWording: We have prioritized a complimentary glass replacement shipping today and applied a $15 service voucher credit to your profile.
outputData.followUpLine: I will personal monitor this delivery, and will send over your new tracking code as soon as it departs our warehouse.

inputData.agentResponse: Calm down, there is no need to write in all caps. Read the manual, the reset button is right on the back panel.

outputData.whatIsGood: Identification of the correct technical troubleshooting step (locating the reset button on the back panel).
outputData.whatNeedsImprovement: Tone is highly defensive and dismissive. Telling a customer to 'calm down' or calling out their formatting (all caps) escalates the tension. The instruction 'read the manual' is cold and feels lazy.
outputData.betterVersion: I understand how frustrating it is when a device isn't working as expected. Let's get this resolved for you. On the very back panel of the device, you will find a small reset button. If you press and hold this button for 5 seconds, it should restore the standard settings. Let me know if you run into any trouble finding it!
outputData.softSkillTip: Never tell a customer to calm down or instruct them what not to write; it invalidates their voice. Instead, join them on their team to solve the problem.

manager_reviews.comment: Excellent improvement, Alice! You framed the policy beautifully. High empathy and clear options. Keep up this magnificent standard of work.

learning_resources.title: Stock Brokerage Phrasing & De-escalation Keys
learning_resources.content: Learn how to transform potentially explosive brokerage customer service situations (including delayed withdrawals, margin warnings, automated trade risk closures, and order rejections) into highly professional, clear, and SEBI/regulatory aligned communications.

items.original: Your request is under process. Please wait.
items.better: We understand the importance of your withdrawal request. Our team is actively processing it and we will keep you updated on the progress.
items.explanation: Validates the payout request priority and sets expectations rather than simply ordering the customer to wait.

items.better: We wish to inform you that the available margin in your account is currently insufficient. Kindly add funds to avoid any interruption in trading activities.
items.explanation: States the standard margin maintenance constraint as a supportive system safeguard to avoid potential trading blocks.

items.original: Interest is applicable as per policy.
items.better: As per the Margin Trading Facility guidelines, interest charges are applicable on utilized amounts. Please let us know if you would like assistance in understanding the calculation.
items.explanation: Wraps Margin Trading Facility (MTF) guidelines in an active, supportive offer to explain calculation mathematics.

items.better: Due to margin requirements and risk management guidelines, the position was squared off automatically to safeguard the account from further exposure.
items.explanation: Positions risk square-offs as standard system safety boundaries to limit losses rather than a hostile action.

items.better: The order could not be executed because of exchange or margin-related restrictions. Please review the order details and we will be happy to assist further.
items.explanation: Offers helpful diagnostics instead of a blunt notification of failed placement.

items.better: We apologize for the inconvenience. Our technical team is investigating the issue and we are working towards a resolution at the earliest.
items.explanation: Expresses corporate accountability and prioritizes rapid technical investigation.

items.better: We appreciate your patience. Your account verification is currently under review and we shall notify you once the activation process is completed.
items.explanation: Uses elite account-activation reassurance language in place of blunt commands.

items.better: DP charges are levied as per depository guidelines. We would be happy to explain the applicable charges in detail if required.
items.explanation: Links Depository Participant (DP) expenses directly toCDSL/NSDL regulatory rules with clear documentation offers.

items.better: We understand your concern regarding the brokerage charges. We are reviewing the transaction details and shall provide complete clarification shortly.
items.explanation: Initiates active double-checks to secure investor confidence in billing transparency.

items.explanation: Identifies key milestones and external depository confirmations to secure full customer visibility.

learning_resources.title: Brokerage Compliance & Regulatory Guardrails
learning_resources.content: Brokerage customer support agents operate under highly strict regulatory standards in volatile market settings. Ensure all written and verbal exchanges remain completely objective, transparent, and carry zero unapproved advisory liability.
checklist: Strictly avoid offering speculative market forecasts, stock picks, or investment recommendations.
Secure account identity verification using clear validation questions before discussing margin levels or open positions.
Whenever explaining DP fees, AMC debits, or stamp duties, cite CDSL/NSDL and official exchange tariff rate sheets.
Frame margin square-offs (RMS) not as punitive actions, but as mechanical compliance boundaries to secure accounts.
Provide direct bank transaction reference details whenever answering delayed fund withdrawal tickets.
